# SOMEWHERE

> SOMEWHERE is a trip planning app for iOS and Android. It brings trip itineraries, day-by-day route maps, and expense tracking and settlement into one planning flow, and lets friends plan the same trip together. Available in Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German and Spanish.

SOMEWHERE (여행 계획 앱 "SOMEWHERE", developed by NP) is not a booking service. It is a planner: users build an itinerary, see each day's route on a map, record trip spending, and share the trip with companions. The app is free to download; optional SOMEWHERE PRO subscriptions provide additional features, so free download does not mean every feature is free.

## Features

- [AI itinerary](https://npsomewhere.com/en/features/ai/): Pick a destination, dates, companions and trip type, and AI builds a day-by-day itinerary that can be refined by chatting with AI.
- [Route map](https://npsomewhere.com/en/features/map/): Places added to the itinerary are connected on the map in visiting order for each day. Includes place search, importing places from Google Maps and directions.
- [Expense splitting](https://npsomewhere.com/en/features/expense/): Log trip expenses in 50 currencies (including Fill with AI from a receipt or payment photo, itemized entries and notes), manage a shared fund, see spending by category, and get a summary of who owes whom.
- [Plan together](https://npsomewhere.com/en/features/together/): Invite friends by link or QR code to edit the same itinerary, map and expenses, with per-friend permissions, across Android and iPhone.
- [Packing list](https://npsomewhere.com/en/features/packing/): Each trip has a shared packing list and a private one for each trip mate, where common essentials can be picked and added at once.
- Weather and trip duplication: Trip date cards show the weather forecast for upcoming dates, and a trip can be duplicated to plan a similar one.
- [Vouchers & tickets](https://npsomewhere.com/en/features/vouchers/): Flight tickets, stay vouchers and other bookings can be saved with photos or PDFs, viewed as reorderable cards or grouped by day, linked to places and expenses, and opened offline.

- [Import places from Google Maps](https://npsomewhere.com/import-place): Guide to saving shared Google Maps places into a trip
